cards.name: Judas Serpent
cards.blurb: A moonlight broker on the garden path, carrying a basket that never quite stays still.

cards.name: Thoth Shoebill
cards.blurb: Keeper of the first letters. What he reads aloud becomes law in the dust of the archive.

cards.name: Tarsier Stargazer
cards.nameJa: ターシャー・スターゲイザー
cards.blurb: The smallest astronomer. Its eyes drink constellations and braid them into violet thread.

cards.name: Eve
cards.blurb: First walker of the green world. Lions rest where she steps; doves keep her name.

cards.name: Bloodfist Bamboo
cards.nameJa: ブラッドフィスト・バンブー
cards.blurb: A monk who broke the vow of stillness. Rain cannot wash the red from his knuckles.

cards.name: Axolotl Regenerator
cards.nameJa: アクソロトル・リジェネレイター
cards.blurb: She unwrites wounds. Water remembers her shape even when the body does not.

cards.name: Ceres Bison
cards.blurb: Harvest sovereign of the long grass. One sweep of the sickle feeds a city through winter.

cards.name: Ninhursag Tuatara
cards.nameJa: ニンフルサグ・トゥアタラ
cards.blurb: Lady of the living mountain. The tablet in her hand is older than rivers.

cards.name: Ezekiel Cherub
cards.blurb: Four faces, many wings, a throne of turning wheels. Sight itself kneels.

cards.name: Raven
cards.blurb: A thief of daylight and a keeper of boxes that should stay shut. The river knows his laugh.

cards.name: Jonah Whale
cards.blurb: Prophet and vessel in one body. The storm listens when the staff strikes the swell.

cards.name: Toxic Ivy Serpent
cards.nameJa: トキシック・アイビーサーペント
cards.blurb: A dryad who chose the fang. Ivy drinks the light; whatever she coils does not rise again.

cards.name: Mary Magdalene
cards.blurb: Witness at the empty tomb. The jar she carries holds a dawn that will not spill.

cards.name: Hwanung Amur
cards.blurb: Prince of the sandalwood altar. He stepped down through cloud so a people could begin.

cards.name: Man o' War Queen
cards.nameJa: マン・オブ・ウォー・クイーン
cards.blurb: A crown of tentacles in the midnight pelagic. Touch is a treaty she does not offer twice.

cards.name: Moses Serpent
cards.blurb: The staff became a living law. Water stands aside when the golden coil speaks.

cards.name: Coyote Trickster
cards.nameJa: コヨーテ・トリックスター
cards.blurb: He steals names and leaves stories. The desert still laughs where his staff last struck.

cards.name: Jesus Lamb
cards.blurb: Shepherd and sacrifice in one quiet hold. Even the lamb knows the road ahead.

cards.name: Jade Emperor Takin
cards.nameJa: ジェイド・エンペラー・ターキン
cards.blurb: Horned sovereign of the cloud palaces. Dragons keep the minutes of his stillness.

cards.name: Shiva Snubnose
cards.nameJa: シヴァ・スノーモンキー
cards.blurb: Destroyer seated in snow. The third eye is a door; the trident is the key.

cards.name: Utu Aardvark
cards.nameJa: ウトゥ・アードヴァーク
cards.blurb: Sun-judge in gilded plate. Dawn is a sentence he writes across the city.

cards.name: Maned Wolf Odin
cards.nameJa: マネドウルフ・オーディン
cards.blurb: One-eyed wanderer of the long spear. Ravens report; the storm answers.

cards.name: Chrono Trigger
cards.blurb: Crono, Lucca, Frog, and Magus under Guardia’s gears. The millennial fair never ended.

cards.name: Chrono Trigger Cave
cards.blurb: Robo in the cavern dark. Crono and Frog hold the line against the den’s beasts.

cards.name: Dragon Quest Hero
cards.nameJa: ドラゴンクエスト・勇者
cards.blurb: The red cap, the map, the slime at his heel. Every monster in the kingdom knows that stare.

cards.name: Dragon Quest VIII
cards.blurb: Yangus, Jessica, the wagon, and a hero on the cliff. The curse of Trodain still walks.

cards.name: Doctor Doom
cards.blurb: Green fire, iron mask, the Latverian theorem. Doom does not ask. Doom concludes.

cards.name: Doctor Doom
cards.blurb: Ink and wash over Latveria. The hood still holds the throne.

cards.name: Kang the Conqueror
cards.nameJa: カン・ザ・コンカラー
cards.blurb: Every century already lost. The cannon on his shoulder is just the clock speaking.

cards.name: Sung Jin-Woo
cards.blurb: Arise. The weakest hunter walks with an army that does not breathe.

cards.name: Naruto
cards.blurb: Kurama in the coat. The sage of the leaf burns gold and does not blink.

cards.name: Naruto
cards.blurb: Color storm around the leaf. One eye still hunts — the other already knows.

cards.name: Abbey Chase
cards.blurb: Wet tile, two pistols, Hammerhead in the drink. Abbey does not wait for backup.

cards.name: Danger Girl
cards.blurb: Three silhouettes, one explosion. Campbell ink — the agency never walks, it drops in.

cards.name: Chrono Trigger Factory
cards.nameJa: クロノ・ファクトリー
cards.blurb: Crono, Lucca, Robo, and the Nu on the factory floor. The future still hums.

cards.name: Legend of the Dragoon
cards.nameJa: レジェンド・オブ・ドラグーン
cards.blurb: Dart, Shana, Rose. Winged species over the moon — the Dragoon spirit still answers.

cards.name: Peace Bear
cards.blurb: Tie-dye, heart tag, the peace sign still holds. A quiet plate in a loud vault.

cards.name: Tanuki Confessor
cards.blurb: Snow in the nave. Gold runs from the cross. He does not ask for mercy — he holds it.

cards.name: Blackbeard
cards.blurb: Gold in the teeth, a shark in the coat. The flag already knows how this ends.

cards.name: Blackbeard Frilled Shark
cards.blurb: Gills in the collar, smoke in the beard. The ship behind him is already burning.

cards.name: Nefertiti
cards.blurb: Ankh in one hand, lotus in the other. The sun still answers to her.

cards.name: Sacagawea
cards.blurb: She points the river. The canoe already knows the way.

cards.name: Amelia Earhart
cards.nameJa: アメリア・イアハート
cards.blurb: Goggles up, feathers in the wind. The horizon was never a wall.

cards.name: Harriet Wolverine
cards.nameJa: ハリエット・ウルヴァリン
cards.blurb: Lantern first. The river is the road. The moon does not tell.

cards.name: Shaka Zulu
cards.blurb: Spear, shield, the army at his back. The grass remembers the step.

cards.name: Boudica Wildcat
cards.nameJa: ブーディカ・ワイルドキャット
cards.blurb: The scream before the charge. Lightning takes her side.

cards.name: Moctezuma II
cards.blurb: Quetzal cloak, the lake city below. The volcano keeps the hour.

cards.name: Kamehameha I
cards.blurb: Feather cloak on the cliff. The islands already answer to one name.

cards.name: Rani Lakshmibai
cards.nameJa: ラクシュミー・バーイー
cards.blurb: Child in one arm, reins in the other. The fortress gate still opens for her.

cards.name: Maui
cards.blurb: The hook that fished the islands. The sun still slows when he asks.

cards.name: P.T. Barnum
cards.blurb: Admit one. The ticket is already gold. The crowd was never the point — he was.

cards.name: Mansa Bongo
cards.blurb: Staff, caravan, the towers in the dust. Gold is not a color here — it is the air.

cards.name: Josephine Baker
cards.nameJa: ジョセフィン・ベーカー
cards.blurb: Horns, fringe, Paris on fire. The marquee already knows her name.

cards.name: Diogenes
cards.blurb: Lantern up, tub down. He is looking for an honest man. The dogs already know.

cards.name: Nikola Tesla
cards.blurb: Two coils, one storm. The city runs on whatever he has not said yet.

cards.name: Sun Wukong
cards.blurb: Staff, cloud, the palace already ducked. The Great Sage does not ask permission.

cards.name: Hokusai Crab
cards.blurb: The brush is a claw. The wave is already on the paper.

cards.name: Hanuman
cards.blurb: Mace, leap, the temples below. Devotion moves faster than the wind.

cards.name: Iron Mask
cards.blurb: Chains, claws, the torch. The mask does not speak. It does not have to.

cards.name: Edgar Allan Poe
cards.nameJa: エドガー・アラン・ポー
cards.blurb: Quill, owl-tuft, the moon over the mausoleum. He is still writing the last line.

cards.name: Shana
cards.blurb: Bow drawn, wings open. The shot is already decided.

cards.name: Shana
cards.blurb: The moon is the range-finder. She does not miss it.

cards.name: Dart
cards.blurb: Crimson scale, green heart. The spear already knows the dragon’s name.

cards.name: Dart
cards.blurb: Flame at the shoulders, the cicada at his back. Endiness still answers.

cards.name: Rose
cards.blurb: Blue eyes, black crystal. The blade is older than the war.

cards.name: Magus
cards.blurb: Green skin, purple coat, the dagger at the ear. He already saw this century.

cards.name: Crono
cards.blurb: Red spikes, yellow scarf, the millennial fair still waiting. Time is a door.

cards.name: The Hero
cards.blurb: Map, dagger, the slime already bounced. The legend starts on foot.

cards.name: Shadow Monarch
cards.blurb: Back to the world. Blue lightning. The army is already behind him.

cards.name: Vader
cards.blurb: Angular visor, pale blade. The breath is the metronome.

cards.name: Vader
cards.blurb: Two suns in the visor. The blade is already lit.

cards.name: Kang
cards.blurb: Arms crossed. The lime-and-purple ring already chose the century.

cards.name: Doctor Doom
cards.blurb: The eye on the chest sees first. Green lightning is the signature.

cards.name: Doom
cards.blurb: Chains, red lining, both hands. Doom does not borrow power.

cards.name: Gambit
cards.blurb: The X is the throw. The staff is already charged.

cards.name: Nostradamus
cards.blurb: Owl, open book, the stars already written. He is only reading ahead.

cards.name: Sun Tzu Golden Monkey
cards.blurb: The bamboo slips are the army. The mountain already lost.

cards.name: Zheng He
cards.blurb: Prow, junks, the gold at dusk. The sea is a road when he says so.

cards.name: Hatshepsut Secretary
cards.blurb: Staff, ankh, the vultures already circle for her. The temple is the letterhead.

cards.name: Flareon
cards.blurb: Flame mane, two siblings. The oil still holds the heat.

cards.name: Houdini
cards.blurb: The tank was never the trick. The tentacles were.

cards.name: Galileo Galilei
cards.blurb: Jupiter is already turning. The lizard already knew.

cards.name: Mata Hari
cards.blurb: The dance is the letter. The tail is the signature.

cards.name: Mwindo
cards.blurb: Born walking, staff first. The storm is the greeting.

cards.name: Hunahpu
cards.blurb: Blowgun, jaguar cloak, the skull cave waiting. The ballgame is later.
